status: completed source-controlled interval study; independently checked
question: Do recorded cord-cluster gaps restrict published account partitions when quantities are withheld?
outcome: Both largest-gap and equal-cord-count rules uniquely recover the two selected partitions. Order plus supplied counts leaves 21 and 78 partitions; order alone leaves 128 and 8,192. Exact gap permutations match the source partition in 20/420 and 2/156 cases. Gap radius 1/4 allows 10 and 12 partitions. Independent checks cover 626 records, 1,097 witnesses and 22,537 exclusions.
challenge: Group counts, source ranges and reference partitions were exposed before protocol; individual pendant positions are absent. Missing and tied distances can preserve many partitions.
remedy: Explicit reference-controlled scope, quantity-free input, supplied-count and count-free rules, equal-size baseline, exact all-tie candidate sets and independent source-interval/certificate checks.
retry_when: Prospectively selected accounts where gap and equal-size rules disagree, measured uncertainty or finer attachment positions supply new evidence.
